title: [Decision] Objects with many actions: a platform-default 「设置」 tab composed from `record_section` actions (spec `group` key + objectui default record page) and a `record_header` count lint
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) on the maintainer's question in this session's chat, verbatim: 「还有很多业务对象都有类似的问题，就是 action很多，这种有好的通用方案吗」 (2026-10-18, right after confirming cloud#3001's design). ⛔ Not a claim. A `needs-user-decision` card: the platform half of cloud#3001, under the maintainer's standing 口径 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (batch #362, objectstack-ai/objectstack#24256).
Dedupe: open objectstack / objectui cards on `record_section`, `settings tab`, `danger zone`, `record_header`: none; cloud#3001 (ruled A — the environment page authored from existing blocks) is the first consumer-side instance; `check-prior-rulings` on these terms: 0 ADR hits.

## 维护者速读

您问的是:动作很多的对象,有没有通用方案。平台今天的做法是页头最多放 3 个按钮,其余全部折进 ⋯ 菜单。spec 里早就有 `record_section`(「记录正文分区/页签里的动作」,文档举的例子就是「安全页签放改密码、两步验证」),也有 `record:quick_actions` 块来摆它们,但默认记录页不画它们 —— 想要「设置」页签,今天每个对象都得自己写一张页面(平台的 `sys_user` 安全页签、cloud 的环境页都是这么做的)。通用方案就是把这件事做进平台:对象把管理类动作声明到 `record_section` 并标一个分组,默认记录页自动长出「设置」页签,按分组分区,`danger` 动作自动落到底部红框;再加一条 lint,页头动作超过 5 个就警告。按源码数,今天真正超出页头的只有两个对象(环境 24 个、用户 10 个),hotcrm 的对象最多 3 个,所以这是提前把路修好,不是救火。需要您定的一点:这件事的渲染部分必然是 objectui 里的 React 代码 —— 它是给所有对象用的渲染器能力,不是某一个页面;如果您对 3001 说的「不在 objectui 用 React」也适用于这里,那就只能选 B。

## What the platform does today (read at objectstack `3fed1eb00af6`, objectui `a8560b228527`, cloud `837e24a4b8b4`, hotcrm `e50d048b9146`)

- **Header fold.** objectui `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:2008–2066`: up to `maxVisible` (default 3, mobile 1; a `page:header` prop) `record_header` actions render as buttons; the rest, and every `record_more`-only action, collapse into the ⋯ menu in three bands (objectui#12529). spec `action.zod.ts:1314–1327`: `order` promotes an action into the primary slot or demotes it toward ⋯. The console also injects 分享, 收藏 and 删除 into every record's ⋯ (`RecordDetailView.tsx:3059–3187`), so a walk of the product shows a fuller menu than the object's own declarations.
- **The vocabulary exists, the default rendering does not.** spec `action.zod.ts:647`: `record_section` = 「actions surfaced inside a body section/tab of a record (e.g. a Security tab grouping change-password, 2FA, etc.)」; `record:quick_actions` (`component.zod.ts`) places them by `actionNames` and `location`. The synthesized default record page draws `record_section` actions only in the approvals decision bar (`RecordDetailView.tsx:3577`). An object gets a settings tab only by authoring a page: `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts:359–495` (a 「安全」 tab of four `record:quick_actions` groups) and, from today's ruling, cloud's environment page (cloud#3001 A).
- **No grouping key.** An action declares `locations`, `order`, `variant` (`primary|secondary|danger|ghost|link`) and `description`; nothing names the section an action belongs to. `ActionDefinition` refuses unknown keys.
- **How many objects are over the fold, by declared metadata.** `record_header` per object: cloud `sys_environment` 24 (cloud#3001); objectstack `sys_user` 10 (+3 `record_section`-only; already authored), `sys_oauth_application` 4, `sys_sso_provider` 3, `sys_organization` 3; cloud `sys_package_version` 4, `sys_domain` 3, `sys_cloud_connection` 3; hotcrm `case` 3, `campaign` 3, the rest ≤2 (`src/*/actions/*.actions.ts`). Two objects exceed the three-button fold by a wide margin; three lose one action into ⋯; everything else fits.

## Options

| Option | What is built | Workload |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **A · Platform default 「设置」 tab (seat's recommendation)** | spec: one optional key on `ActionDefinition`, `group` (an i18n label — the heading of the section the action sits under); `os check` lint: more than 5 `record_header` actions on one object → warning naming `record_more` / `record_section`. objectui: the synthesized default record page adds a 「设置」 tab when the object declares ≥1 `record_section` action — sections by `group` (ungrouped under 「常规」), one row per action (label, `description` as the line of context, the button), `variant: 'danger'` actions in a red-bordered 「危险操作」 zone at the bottom whatever their group; the same `visible` / params / confirm path as the header. Authored pages are untouched. Consumers: move management actions from `record_header` to `record_section`, set `group`; no page authoring. | spec S · objectui M · each consumer S; two pins before cloud / hotcrm use it |
| **B · Guard only** | the `os check` lint above, plus the existing levers (`record_more`, `order`, `maxVisible`); a settings tab stays an authored page per object (`sys_user`, the environment page) | spec S; no generic page |
| **C · Convention only** | no platform change; the authoring docs name the pattern (a `page:tabs` 「设置」 of `record:quick_actions` groups) and every object copies it | docs |

## Recommendation: A

- **Long-term fit.** The spec already names `record_section` with exactly this example; what the platform lacks is the default rendering, and the 口径 says build it in the platform. One new key, no new location, no new block. B and C leave every application re-authoring the same tab.
- **Business pull.** Real on cloud (24 actions met on staging), authored by hand twice already (`sys_user`, the environment page); by declared metadata no third object is over the fold yet, so A is road-building ahead of the next object, not a fire. The maintainer's walk reports more objects than the metadata shows; the injected 分享 / 收藏 / 删除 account for part of that.
- **AI-error surface.** `group` is strict-validated as a key; a misspelled group *value* makes a visible extra heading, not a silent drop. The lint catches the habit of piling new actions into `record_header`. A default tab means no hand-written page per object to get wrong.
- **Startup, no spread.** A touches spec and objectui once; consumers move `locations` only; no governed file. B is one lint; C builds nothing.
- **The one thing to confirm.** A's rendering half is React in objectui — a renderer capability every object gets from metadata, which is the platform's job, unlike a one-object page (what 「不应该在objectui 中用react做」 refused on cloud#3001). If that sentence applies here too, the answer is B.
- **Nothing waits on A.** Any object can have the tab today by authoring a page as `sys_user` and the environment page do.

## Execution

- **A:** the director files, after the letter: an objectstack spec card p2 `pm:queue` (`group` key, docs, the lint, with `sys_user`'s own actions as the first declarer); an objectui default-page card p2 `pm:blocked` on the spec pin; no cloud or hotcrm card until an object needs the tab (the environment page stays authored per cloud#3001 A).
- **B:** one objectstack spec card p2 (the lint).
- **C:** one docs line, no card.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性:A —— spec 早已声明 `record_section`,缺的只是默认渲染;按口径进平台;只加一个 `group` 键,不加位置、不加块;B/C 让每个应用重复写同一张页签。
② 实际业务拉动:cloud 真实(staging 撞上 24 个);已手写两次(`sys_user`、环境页);按元数据今天没有第三个对象超出页头,A 是提前修路;您走查看到的更多,部分来自控制台注入的分享/收藏/删除。
③ 防 AI 犯错:`group` 键严格校验,值写错是多出一个可见标题而非静默丢失;lint 拦住往页头堆动作的习惯;默认页签免去每对象手写页面。
④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 只改 spec 与 objectui 各一次,消费方只挪 `locations`;不碰受管文件;B 一条 lint;C 不建。
Prior rulings read: cloud#3001 ruling A(环境页用现有块拼「设置」页签)· cloud#2774 第一阶段 `6122033877` · 总监席 batch #362 口径「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」(#24256)· spec `record_section` / `record:quick_actions` 文档 · objectui#2361 / #12529(页头折叠)→ 4 hits; ADR none; thread: 0
